hooks.name: Pre-submit: full gate
hooks.description: When a spec task is marked complete (PostTaskExec — a documented trigger in the IDE and CLI v3), run the full submission gate: the whole test suite, strict type-check, the Maker build, the real-browser checks, the sample freshness check, the task-trace check and the README claim checker. Not `Manual`: kiro.dev/docs/hooks/types lists Manual hooks as not invocable in CLI v3, and the IDE no longer creates them. To run it on demand, use the steering file `pre-submit` (type `/pre-submit` in chat) or run `npm run pre-submit`.
